# HerdAnimal

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/animals/herd.h`](../../../src/logic/animals/herd.h) · Described in `data/animals.json`

On each animal of a herd: its herd and whether it walks.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `herd` | `uint32_t` | Index of its herd's kind. |
| `cell` | `glm::ivec2` | Cell of the world its herd belongs to. |
| `moving` | `bool` | It walks. |
| `speed` | `float` | m/s over the ground. |

## Notes

Made by Herds at spawn; removed (the entity kept) when the herd despawns while the animal is steered. SteeredWalk starts from its speed.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: SteeredWalk. Written by: Herds. Created by: Herds. Destroyed by: Herds.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Herds](../systems/Herds.md) | system | Host | **readwrite+create+destroy** | spawn, updateMember, despawn | Kind and cell at spawn; moving and speed every tick; removed from steered members when the herd goes. |
| [SteeredWalk](../systems/SteeredWalk.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | The speed the herd had the animal walking, to start from. |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[Herds](../systems/Herds.md)**
  - Reads the herd definition JSON under ./resources/ in init.
  - Creates and destroys member entities as the viewer moves (destroying every component on them).
  - Logs warnings for missing members, an error for a bad definition, an info line at init, a debug line per herd spawned.
  - Queries the ground field per member per tick and the generator's heightfield for slopes.
- **[SteeredWalk](../systems/SteeredWalk.md)**
  - Adds and removes the SteeredWalk component, which Herds watches to let go of and take back its members.
  - Queries the ground field per walking animal per tick.
